visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful young woman with dark hair tied back sits behind a white circular table, holding several colorful gacha capsules. She wears a grey camisole and smiles warmly at the camera. The background consists of a plain white wall and a brown fabric sofa. (2) She opens a blue capsule and pulls out a flat, plastic-wrapped object. She holds it up to the lens, displaying a brown, folded material that resembles an uninflated violin instrument. Her expressions are curious and excited as she handles the new gacha toy. (3) The woman begins to blow air vigorously into a valve on the side of the plastic violin. Her cheeks puff out noticeably with each breath. A bright yellow glowing animation overlay appears around her head to emphasize the physical effort required to inflate it. (4) Once fully inflated, the item takes the shape of a small violin body attached to a clear, U-shaped inflatable neck pillow. She puts the clear pillow around her neck and rests her head against the brown violin body, closing her eyes for demonstration. (5) Green screen overlays change the background to show the interior of a moving car and then an airplane cabin with clouds outside the window. She remains in the center, demonstrating how the violin pillow can be used for sleeping during long travel trips. (6) She displays a second, darker brown inflatable violin next to the original one. She points out the wood-grain texture printed on the surface of the premium version, comparing the visual details and colors between the two distinct gacha items on the table. (7) Holding a long, thin inflatable bow, she performs a comical and exaggerated mime of playing the violin. Her facial expressions are intense and goofy as she sweeps the bow across the inflated instrument with fast, energetic movements while maintaining a theatrical, musician-like posture. (8) To wrap up, she leans her elbows on the white table, holding both violins and the bow playfully. She smiles broadly at the viewer while final social media handles and colorful recommendation graphics appear as overlays on the screen before the cut.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration starts immediately alongside a fast-tempo, upbeat synth-pop track. The voice is enthusiastic and projected. Sharp plastic clicking sounds occur as gacha capsules are handled on the table surface. (2) Pronounced rustling sounds of plastic packaging are heard as the product is unwrapped. The BGM maintains a steady 4/4 beat while the speaker continues her rapid-fire commentary about the item. (3) A sequence of rhythmic puffing or blowing sounds is clearly audible, indicating physical exertion. This is accompanied by a melodic 'magic' chime sound effect that adds a whimsical layer to the mix. (4) The audio transitions into a comical demonstration phase. A 'whoosh' transition SFX is followed by a looped, deep snoring sound effect while the background music drops in volume to emphasize the joke. (5) The speaker begins a series of vocalized buzzing sounds ('bee-bee-bee') at a very high speed to mimic the 'Flight of the Bumblebee'. The background music shifts to a fast classical violin arrangement. (6) Sudden percussive 'thud' sound effects match the visual mime of the violin bow hitting the inflatable body. The speaker's voice reaches peak volume and arousal, displaying high vocal intensity and comedic strain. (7) A comedic 'boing' SFX is heard as she poses. The BGM shifts back to a lighthearted pop melody. The narration slows down as she discusses the price and value of the gacha items. (8) Closing remarks are delivered in a friendly, conversational tone with standard brightness. The audio ends with a final upbeat musical swell and a crisp 'ding' bell SFX to mark the conclusion of the video.
